hook.notes: Premium dark-rose start screen; Palette icon (Lucide); crisp tagline; SwipeInstructions on first visit adds an engaging tutorial

coreGameFeel.notes: Wobbling drops, glow specular, particle bursts on hit, responsive touch — 40px tap radius is generous; miss flash + near-miss (white pulse) added in QA

escalation.notes: 3-stage speed escalation (1→2→3 drops, fall duration halves from 2500→1200ms); combo 1.5× / 2× multipliers; color change every 10s with screen flash + audio

endScreen.notes: 4 personality types, 4 insight chips (Accuracy/Avg Reaction/Best Streak/Correct Hits), score count-up, personal best badge, share/leaderboard CTAs

audio.notes: Comprehensive coverage. Drive music (145BPM) creates urgency. All events covered: tap hit, miss, combo milestones, tick, warning, color change, game end. Fixed: combo audio now fires synchronously (removed setTimeout delay)

visualPolish.notes: Deep rose gradient background; ambient glow shifts with target color (beautiful detail); pulsing color swatch; glowing drops with specular highlight

sensorUsage.notes: Clean single-tap mechanic; touchAction: none on canvas; 40px tap radius; haptics on every interaction; 7 haptic events fired per test run

behavioralSignal.notes: correctTaps, wrongTaps, reactionTimes[], accuracy, maxStreak, score, streakCurrent all captured. 4 personality archetypes based on accuracy×reaction speed cross. WebhookEmitter fires on end.

loadPerformance.notes: Lightweight canvas game. Build passes. Memory stable (no leak across 3 play-agains). JS heap <150MB.

brandFit.notes: Chromatic theme highly adaptable via useBrandTheme(). Sophisticated enough for CPG/beverage brand activations (Kraft Heinz palette would be perfect). Premium dark aesthetic.

bugs.title: Unused imports: playVictoryFanfare, playNearMiss
bugs.description: Two audio function imports were included but never called, causing dead code and potential confusion during future audio audits.
bugs.fix: Removed both unused imports from the import statement.

bugs.title: Combo milestone audio fired 100ms late via setTimeout
bugs.description: sfx.success() and sfx.powerOn() at 5x/10x streaks were delayed via setTimeout(fn, 100), causing audio to desync 100ms after the visual combo flash. Violates audio-timing spec: combo sounds should fire synchronously with the combo event.
bugs.fix: Removed setTimeout wrappers. Combo audio now fires synchronously in the same handleTap handler as the visual comboFlashAlpha trigger.

bugs.title: window as any casts for FPS tracking
bugs.description: FPS test instrumentation used (window as any).__raf_fps — two instances of as any TypeScript cast violating the zero-any-cast rule.
bugs.fix: Replaced with (window as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).__raf_fps — type-safe access without any.

bugs.title: No near-miss visual feedback for missed correct drops
bugs.description: When a correct color drop reached the bottom without being tapped, only a streak reset and sfx.collision() fired. No visual cue indicated what the player missed. This made the miss feel invisible.
bugs.fix: Added nearMissFlashAlpha state (0.5 opacity on miss). Rendered as a brief white pulse flash overlay (~8 frames at 60fps). Resets on play-again and game start.

bugs.title: Play-again returned to start screen instead of going directly to countdown
bugs.description: handlePlayAgain() called setPhase('start') which required the player to tap 'Start' again. Poor UX — player already registered and consented.
bugs.fix: Changed handlePlayAgain to setPhase('countdown') directly, skipping the start screen on replay. Player session data is already captured on first start.

creativDirectorReview.logline: Color Cascade is the anxiety of perfect attention — a test of whether your eyes can move faster than the rainbow falls.

cannes.note: Crafted with care; emotional arc through escalation is solid, but lacks a singular surprising peak moment

webby.note: Interaction model is self-evident; flow from start to personality reveal is clean and fast

awwwards.note: The rose/magenta aesthetic is distinctive but drop shapes are circles — more visual identity possible

grammy.note: Comprehensive audio coverage; drive music creates urgency; color change shimmer is a premium touch

clio.note: Classic mechanic elevated by behavioral capture and personality classification — gives it commercial purpose

disney.note: Needs a stronger magic moment at the color change — current flash is functional but not theatrical

creativDirectorReview.theMagicMoment: Hitting a 5+ streak and seeing the combo flash ignite in rose gold — the multiplier feeling is visceral.
creativDirectorReview.thePlus: Disney Note: Add a color cascade effect when the target changes — a 0.5s background rain of the new hue before it settles. Both beautiful and functional.
strengthsTopThree: Ambient glow that shifts toward target color — subconsciously primes the player for color changes
3-stage escalation is elegant — you feel the difficulty without being told
Personality types (Chromatic Hawk, Speed Demon, Deliberate Eye, Casual Tapper) are memorable and shareable
improvementsTopThree: Drops are plain circles — a teardrop or prism shard shape would give more visual identity
Combo milestone feedback (×1.5 at 5x, ×2 at 10x) needs a more theatrical streak counter
Color change moment could be more dramatic — currently flash + shimmer, could add cascading particles

playtestPersonalities.description: Fast AND precise — elite color-matching reflexes
Blazingly fast tapper, speed over precision
Measured and accurate, takes their time
